title: Apartment Cleanouts Services
h1: Complete Apartment Cleanout Services, Done Right

blocks.text: Complete Apartment Cleanout Services, Done Right
From a single room to the entire unit — cleared, hauled.

items.title: Serving tenants, landlords & property managers across the GTA
Insured, uniformed crews experienced in condo & apartment buildings

c: Clearing out an entire apartment is a different beast than tossing a few bags of junk. {{fact:utilityDisconnection}}

We work with tenants who are moving out, landlords preparing units for turnover, families managing estate situations, and property managers dealing with abandoned belongings. Every job starts with a free, upfront quote based on the volume being removed — never on your time pressure. Serving the entire Greater Toronto Area, we make apartment cleanouts fast, affordable, and responsibly handled.

image.alt: Apartment Cleanouts: Live Junk Free job photo

blocks.text: Lease Deadline Looming? We Clear Apartments on Short Notice

c: Few things create more stress than an apartment that needs to be empty by a certain date. Whether you’re a tenant facing a final walkthrough, a landlord who just got the keys back to a unit full of leftovers, or a family clearing a loved one’s home, waiting days for a junk company isn’t an option. Our crews regularly complete same-day and next-day cleanouts, arriving with a truck, tools, and enough hands to clear a full unit in a single visit, subject to scheduling.

We remove everything you point at — furniture, mattresses, appliances, electronics, boxes, bagged items, and general clutter — and we sort as we go. Usable furniture and household goods are donated where possible. You get an empty apartment; the landfill gets as little as possible.
Wondering what an apartment cleanout costs? Pricing is based on how much space your items take in our truck, and we give you a firm number before any work begins.
Call us now at +1 647 922 5865 or book online at LiveJunkFree.ca.

blocks.text: Full-Service Apartment Cleanouts – One Crew, Planned Around Your Building

c: An apartment cleanout involves far more than hauling junk. Elevators need to be booked, common hallways protected, oversized furniture dismantled to fit through doorways, and dozens of decisions made about what gets donated, recycled where possible, or discarded. Doing it alone means days of exhausting trips; hiring us means it’s finished in hours.

At Live Junk Free, we’ve cleared studio apartments, multi-bedroom condos, basement suites, and everything in between. Whether it’s an end-of-lease move-out, a downsizing project, an estate cleanout, a renovation prep, or an abandoned-unit turnover for a property manager, we adapt the crew size and truck capacity to the job.
{{fact:propertyProtection}}. Inside the unit, we do the dismantling, bagging, and carrying, so you never lift a thing.

items: Room-by-room clearing – Bedrooms, kitchens, closets, balconies, and storage lockers fully emptied
Sort, donate & recycle – Usable items donated, recyclables diverted, and the unit left

Organized, Respectful, and Thorough from Door to Door

items: Every cleanout follows a plan. We walk the unit with you (or your photos), confirm what stays and what goes, then work room by room — dismantling large furniture, boxing loose items, and carrying everything out through protected pathways. Fragile situations like estate cleanouts are handled with extra patience and discretion.
Before we leave and do a final walkthrough with you, so the apartment is genuinely ready for inspection, staging, new tenants, or renovation crews.

items.q: What does your apartment cleanout service include?
a: Everything from dismantling to hauling. We clear furniture, appliances, mattresses, electronics, boxes, clothing, and general clutter from every room, closet, balcony, and storage locker — leaving the unit broom-clean.

items.q: How long does an apartment cleanout take?
a: Most studio and one-bedroom units are cleared in two to four hours. Larger apartments or heavily filled units may take longer or require a second truck, but the vast majority of cleanouts are completed in a single visit.

items.q: How much does an apartment cleanout cost?
a: Pricing is based on the volume your items occupy in our truck, not on hourly rates. Send photos or book a free on-site assessment, and you’ll receive a firm quote before any work begins — with no add-on fees afterward.

items.q: Do you work with landlords and property managers?
a: Yes, regularly. {{fact:changedScope}}. We can also coordinate access, elevator bookings, and building requirements directly.

items.q: Can you clean out an apartment in a high-rise building?
a: Absolutely. Our crews work in high-rise condos and apartment buildings every week. We follow building move-out procedures, reserve service elevators when required, and protect lobbies, hallways, and elevator interiors throughout the job.
